issue.title: [Bug] list_directory fails to ignore directories when .gitignore patterns contain a trailing slash

steps: Create .gitignore containing dist/ followed by a newline, and create dist/bundle.js and dist/index.html with dummy contents. Call list_directory on . with recursive=true and show the raw result.
expected: Directories matched by a trailing-slash .gitignore rule are excluded.
defect: list_directory enters dist and lists its children because directory paths are checked without a trailing slash.

fault location.explanation: The ignore matcher receives a plain directory name such as dist for a directory-only rule dist/. The missing slash makes the package ignore test false, so traversal continues.

Root cause: The ignore matcher receives a plain directory name such as dist for a directory-only rule dist/. The missing slash makes the package ignore test false, so traversal continues.
